journal_lines: Wedged in a root: a circlet of bone and river-iron. Old and deliberate. Brought it home.
Something made, not natural. Bone worked into a circle. Very old. Brought it anyway.
Found it half-buried at the base of an old tree. Bone and wire, shaped with intention.
The crown was small. Was made for the head of something I did not want to picture.
Bone and antler woven with copper wire green with age. Carried it gently.
Whoever wore it last did not need it anymore. Whoever made it last had hands.
Set it down to look at it. Picked it up again. Could not say why either time.
Older than craft. Older than people, possibly. Brought it home regardless.
